title: ExPhy: A Benchmark for Explicit Physical Property Learning in Multi-Object Trajectory Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.20009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding object dynamics requires not only predicting future trajectories but also examining whether a model captures the physical properties that govern motion. However, existing benchmarks rarely expose object-level physical properties as explicit evaluation targets alongside trajectory forecasting. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{ExPhy}, a multi-object trajectory forecasting benchmark containing 24,000 simulated physical scenes with explicit object-level labels for mass, friction, and restitution. ExPhy provides observed and future trajectories together with an in-distribution (ID) split and two out-of-distribution (OOD) splits over physical parameters (OOD-Parameter) and initial states (OOD-Initial) for jointly evaluating trajectory forecasting and physical property estimation. translated_title: ExPhy：多物体轨迹预测中显式物理属性学习的基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20009v1 公告类型：新 摘要：理解物体动力学不仅需要预测未来轨迹，还需要检查模型是否捕捉到控制运动的物理属性。然而，现有基准很少将物体级别的物理属性作为显式评估目标与轨迹预测一起呈现。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了*ExPhy*，一个包含24,000个模拟物理场景的多物体轨迹预测基准，具有质量、摩擦和恢复系数的显式物体级标签。ExPhy提供观察到的和未来的轨迹，以及一个分布内（ID）划分和两个关于物理参数（OOD-参数）和初始状态（OOD-初始）的分布外（OOD）划分，用于联合评估轨迹预测和物理属性估计。我们进一步实例化了*PhyODE*，一个具有显式属性接口的物理引导模型，从观察中估计物理属性。
tldr: 该论文提出了ExPhy基准，首次将物体级物理属性（质量、摩擦和恢复系数）作为显式评估目标与多物体轨迹预测结合，并引入PhyODE模型验证了这一方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ExPhy benchmark, which for the first time integrates explicit object-level physical properties (mass, friction, and restitution) as evaluation targets with multi-object trajectory forecasting, and instantiates PhyODE model to validate this approach.
